checks.name: coordinates_inside_stated_country
checks.detail: 37 points fall more than 10 km outside the stated country (Natural Earth 1:50m, present-day borders). Top stated countries: {'Ukraine': 36, 'Russia': 1}. Expected where the source codes the state that existed at the time (UCDP: 'Serbia (Yugoslavia)' for 1991-99 events in Croatia, Bosnia and Kosovo; 'Russia (Soviet Union)' for 1989-91 events in the Caucasus) and in contested areas (Natural Earth draws Crimea as Russia; UCDP codes it Ukraine).

transformations: Selected UCDP region containing 'Europe': 2830 of 16633 global events.
Releases combined in order: GEDEvent_v26_01_26_09.csv; duplicate ids resolved to the latest release.
Restricted to events starting in 2026 (the year after the latest annual GED).
PROVISIONAL: Candidate data relax the 25-death annual threshold and are revised in the annual GED; counts are not comparable with UCDP GED.
event_date = date_start (events spanning several days are dated by their start).
date_uncertain = date_prec > 1 (date known only to a range of days or wider).
location_precise = where_prec in {1, 2} (exact place or within ~25 km).
event_type = UCDP type_of_violence label; fatalities = UCDP 'best' estimate.
Country names mapped to ISO3 (e.g. 'Russia (Soviet Union)' -> RUS).
